name: Model retries per day
description:
Shows: Failed model requests the fallback logic counted, per day, agent and model, by reason: overload_wait (a Gemini 503 "high demand" waited out on the same model, 20/40/60 s), throttled_wait (a per-minute throttle waited out), throttled, stall, server_error, transport_error, daily_quota. Reads the factory.model_retry span event.
Why it matters: Retries add latency and eat into the call budget and the run's time limit. The reason split separates provider problems (overload_wait, server_error, stall: Gemini is overloaded, retry later) from our own pressure on rate limits (throttled, throttled_wait, daily_quota). Many overload_wait plus server_error rows explain research timeouts and model_overloaded failures that are not the issue's fault.
